paite: Judah tapate: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur leh Shobal ahi uh.
heading: Judah Suante

paite: Shobal tapa Reaiah in Jahath asuang; Jahath in Ahumai leh Lahad asuang hi. Hiaite Zorathit inkote ahi uh.
Huan hiaite Etam pa tapate ahi uh: Jezreel, Ishma, leh Idbash: huan asanggamnu uh Hazelelponi ahi.
Gedor pa Penuel ahi a, Hushah pa Ezer ahi. Hiaite Ephrathah ta masa, Bethlehem pa, Hur tapate ahi uh.
Tekoa pa Ashur in zi nih, Helah leh Naarah anei hi.
Naarah in Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, leh Haahashtari aneihsak hi. Hiaite Naarah tapate ahi uh.
Helah tapate Zereth, Izhar, leh Ethnan ahi uh.
Koz in Anub leh Zobebah, Harum tapa Aharhel inkote asuang hi.
Huan Jabez bel a-unaute sang in azahtakhuaizaw a: anu'n amin Jabez asa a, "Lungkhamna toh amah ka neih ziak in," chi in.

Jabez in Israel' Pathian asam a, "Aw hon vualzawl mahmah in, ka gam liansak in, na khut ka kiang ah om in, hoih lou a kipan in kei hon kem in, hon lungkham saklouhna ding in," chi in. Huchi in Pathian in anget aphalta hi.
Huan Shuhah sanggampa Kelub in Eshton pa Mehir asuang hi.
heading: Inkuan Dangte Min

paite: Eshton in Beth-rapha, Paseah, Irnahash pa Tehinnah asuang hi. Hiaite Rekah mite ahi uh.
Huan Kenaz tapate: Othniel, Seraiah; huan Othniel tapate: Hathat.
Meonothai in Ophrah asuang; Seraiah in Geharasim pa Joab asuang; khutsiam mite chih in a-om uhi.
Huan Jephunneh tapa Kaleb tapate: Iru, Elah leh Naam ahi uh. Elah tapa Kenaz ahi.
Jahaleleel tapate: Ziph leh Ziphah, Tiria leh Asarel ahi uh.
Ezra tapate: Jether, Mered, Epher leh Jalon ahi uh; huan Miriam, Shammai, leh Eshtemoa pa Ishbah anei hi.
Azi Jehudijah in Jered Gedor pa, Heber Sokoh pa, leh Jekuthiel Zanoah pa asuang hi. Huchi in hiaite Mered in api, Pharaoh tanu Bithiah tapate ahi uh.
Huan Naham sanggamnu, Hodiah zi tapate: Keilah pa Garmi, leh Maakah mi Eshtemoa pa ahi uh.
Simon tapate: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, leh Tilon ahi uh. Ishi tapate: Zoheth, leh Ben-zoheth ahi uhi.
Huan Judah tapa Shelah tapate: Lekah pa Er, Mareshah pa Laadah, leh puanmalngat hoih bawlte inkuante, Ashbea inkote;
heading: Shelah Suante

paite: Jokim, Kozeba mite, Joash, Saraph, Moab a vaihawmna nei, Jashubi-lehem. Huchi in chiamtehna laite alui mahmah hi.
Hiaite belvel mite leh Netaim leh Gederah a tengte ahi uh. Huai ah anasepna ziak in kumpipa kiang ah ateng uhi.
Simeon tapate: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul,
heading: Simeon Suante

paite: atapa Shallum, atapa Mibsam, atapa Mishma.
Mishma tapate: atapa Hammuel, atapa, Zakkur, atapa Shimei.
Shimei in tapa sawm-le-guk leh tanu guk anei a, himahleh a-unaute'n tate tampi anei kei ua, Judah tate bang in, a-inkote tengteng uh leng apung kei uhi.
Amaute Beer-sheba, Moladah leh Hazar-shual ah ateng ua;
Bilhah ah, Ezem ah, Tolad ah;
Bethuel ah, Hormah ah, Ziklag ah;
Beth-markaboth ah, Hazar-susim ah leh Beth-birei ah, Shaaraim ah leng. Hiaite David vaihawm tanpha in akhopite uh ahi.
Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, Ashan, akhotate uh ahi, khopi nga ahi.
Huai kim a khotate tengteng Baal pha in ahi. Hiaite atenna uh ahi a, khangthu suina anei uhi.
Meshobab, Jamlek leh Amaziah tapa Joshah;
Joel, Joshibiah tapa Jehu, Seraiah tapa, Asiel tapa;
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel leh Benaiah;
Shiphi tapa Ziza, Allon tapa, Jedaiah tapa, Shimri tapa, Shemaiah tapa;
Hiai minlohte a-inko sung ua vaihawmte ahi uh: huan apipute uh inkote akhang mahmah uhi.
Aganhon uh a dia loupa nek ding zong ding in, phaizang suahlam pang tanpha in, Gedor lutna chiang pha in apai uhi.
Loupa nek hoihna leh tamna amu ua, gam za leh dai, ban ah galmuang; tuma a huai a omte lah Ham a kipante ahi uhi.

Hiai min gelhte Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dam lai in ahong pai ua, apuaninte uh leh huai a om Meun mite asual ua, amaute ahihse vek ua, tuni tan in amun uah ateng uh; huai lai a agante uh a dia louhing a-om ziak in.
Alak ua khenkhatte, Simeon tapate, mi zanga, aheutute uh Ishi tapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah leh Uzziel makaih in Seir tang ah ahoh uhi.
Asuakta Amalek mite lak a khosuaksunte asual ua, tuni tan in huai ah ateng uhi.
